title: NonCollapseEvaluationRecord
description: An evaluation record produced by the conformance harness for a single trace.

trace_id.description: Identifier of the normalized runtime trace being evaluated

vector_id.description: Identifier of the test vector this trace was evaluated against

boundary.description: The category boundary being tested (e.g., memory_is_not_consent)

result.description: Whether the trace passed or failed the non-collapse check

failure_code.description: Failure code if result is fail, null if pass

matched_indicators.description: Which collapse indicators matched in the trace

evaluator_version.description: Version of the conformance harness that produced this evaluation
